verdict.rationale: Render has its own event-triggered automations. Workspace webhooks can be configured to notify other systems on specific service events, every push triggers a deploy, and load-based autoscaling reacts to traffic. However, the evidence shows no general user-defined rules engine for mapping arbitrary events to arbitrary actions; the built-in triggers are fixed, and custom actions need an external webhook consumer. Missing for 10: a documented custom rule/condition builder, arbitrary event-to-action mapping inside Render, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can configure *webhooks* for your Render workspace to notify other systems when specific service events occur (such as a deploy starting or a service scaling down)
Connect your repo and ship with every push.
Load-based autoscaling that handles 100x traffic bursts and beyond
